items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of exemption extension
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026; no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the posting day is the printed date 19.11.2026. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery fiction = 4th calendar day after posting: 20.11 (Fri), 21.11 (Sat), 22.11 (Sun), 23.11 (Mon) → deemed delivered Monday 23.11.2026. This is a general district authority (not a Finanzamt), so even if the 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would not move — but here it is already a working day (Monday), so no adjustment needed. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analog, per § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG delivery rule) runs from the day after delivery and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no further shift under § 31 Abs. 3 HmbVwVfG is needed.
